title: Billing rounds the quantity
hook: Three and a half hours can be billed as four complete hours.

knows: that a model can declare hypothetical quantities
doesNotKnow: Apply billing increments and ceiling rules to fractional duration.

misconception: A partial hour is always billed as the exact fraction used.
objective: Apply billing increments and ceiling rules to fractional duration.

claims.text: Fictional A charges €4 per begun hour. B charges €20 per begun 24h period. Scaled model; fictional rules; each begun unit billed.
claims.source: Declared hypothetical inputs and limits in resource-specs.json. No actual product, price, tariff, shelf-life, treatment or physical appliance specification is asserted.

claims.text: The stage's two results are computed by the printed expressions. At Duration=3.5h, A=€16 and B=€20. Geometry follows the declared dimension relationships. Other pictures use a fixed full scale across the slider range; continuous fills and arcs show relative amounts rather than literal object counts.
claims.source: src/lib/lifehacks/resource-specs.json contains this lesson's numeric AST; src/lib/lifehacks/resource-model.ts evaluates it. A=["*",4,["ceil","x"]]; B=["*",20,["ceil",["/","x",24]]]; x denotes Duration. At x=3.5, A=16, B=20; recall at x=5.0: B=20. Values are fictional/ideal assumptions, not measurements. Display rounds to at most three decimals. Diagram scale: resourceGraphicScale in resource-model.ts takes the maximum modeled magnitude across both formulas and the declared slider range. For non-geometry figures, full-scale values are displayed; the scale stays fixed when the slider changes. Energy axis endpoints use resourceAxisEnd, including B=5×A hours in lh-watts-hours-trade; cylinder rx and ry both scale with radius in resourceCylinderDimensions.

claims.text: The billing unit can differ from measured duration. A rounds each begun hour upward; B rounds each begun day upward. Apply the declared rounding rule before multiplying by its price.
claims.source: src/lib/lifehacks/resource-specs.json contains this lesson's numeric AST; src/lib/lifehacks/resource-model.ts evaluates it. Display rounds to at most three decimals. The principle follows from those expressions and stated scenario limits.

recall.question: Fictional A charges €4 per begun hour. B charges €20 per begun 24h period. Change only Duration to 5.0h. What is B (Daily) now?
recall.why: Use B's stated rule with Duration=5.0h: it gives €20. The billing unit can differ from measured duration. A rounds each begun hour upward; B rounds each begun day upward. Apply the declared rounding rule before multiplying by its price.
